claims.summary: `llm.rs` is an explicit compatibility facade separating public generation APIs from crate-private provider mechanics.
claims.disposition: Verified from the complete report-bound 27-line facade and current source; the later rustfmt-only line wrap changes no exported item.

claims.summary: Flat re-exports may fragment request context or lose vibrancy texture between the facade and provider.
claims.disposition: Source verification does not support the inferred loss. Introspection context is assembled in one provider call; vibrancy and pressure accessors belong to codec and self-model surfaces rather than the introspection request.

claims.summary: The facade signature for `generate_introspection_detailed` should remain aligned with the provider entry point.
claims.disposition: Implemented as a trybuild compile-pass case for both public generation entry points; current orchestration call sites and strict Clippy also compile.

claims.summary: A unified `Request` object may be needed to combine pressure/vibrancy state with generation actions.
claims.disposition: Not supported as an implementation need. The current separation prevents codec control observations from silently becoming model-request inputs; no control, prompt, or model-behavior change is made.
